name: Palette The Travellers Hotel Bangkok
detail: The MRT is quiet and peaceful, but it's a bit hard to find food. It's about 300 meters away from 7-Eleven. I couldn't use the Wi-Fi both nights. The air conditioning is very cold. The hot water is warm to the point of being hot. Overall, it's worth it.

name: Solaria Nishitetsu Hotel Bangkok
detail: I used it when traveling to the Queen Sirikit Convention Center. It is directly connected to BTS Asok / MRT Sukhumvit station. When you get off at the station, there are arrows pointing to the hotel above, which is convenient as you can reach the convention center without getting wet from the rain. The station is also directly connected to Terminal 21, making it easy to find places to eat. The room wasn't large, but it was spacious for a Japanese-style hotel, and it was comfortable with good facilities. The staff are also very friendly. (There are staff members who speak Korean!) I haven't had the chance to use the breakfast, bar, or pool.

name: Palette Hi Hotel Bangkok
detail: Room with a good location Review of a room that is beautiful, clean, and offers great value. There are various types and sizes of rooms to choose from, ranging from standard rooms to executive suites, which are very spacious, perfect for relaxing whether you're here for work, a getaway with a partner, family, or hanging out with friends. It's very convenient for traveling, close to shopping malls, the sky train, fresh markets, and night markets. Importantly, the staff here are friendly, polite, and provide excellent service. Highly recommended! Hi Hotel Bangkok ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐🥰🥰

name: Pullman Bangkok Hotel G
detail: I stayed at Pullman Bangkok Hotel G for three nights, from September 8 to 11, 2026, and I truly enjoyed every moment of my stay. The service was excellent from beginning to end, starting with the warm welcome from the Front Office team to the lovely staff at TIVA, the breakfast restaurant. Everyone was friendly, attentive, and provided exceptional service. The room was spacious and very comfortable, with wonderfully cool air conditioning throughout the day. I slept extremely well every night. The atmosphere was so peaceful and relaxing that it was hard to believe the hotel is located right in the middle of such a vibrant city. The location is also very convenient, with easy access to many places around Bangkok. I had a wonderful three-night stay and would definitely recommend Pullman Bangkok Hotel G to anyone looking for a comfortable, peaceful, and well-located hotel with excellent service.

name: The Landmark Bangkok
detail: This was a last-minute booking due to a flight delay, but it turned out to be the kindest and most comfortable place among the three accommodations I stayed at during this trip. Although it's an older establishment and not a trendy new hotel or an Instagram-worthy spot, the details of older Bangkok hotels that can’t be seen in newer ones are great, and the service from the staff is very comforting. In fact, it’s not uncommon to encounter expensive places where faucets splash a lot, toilets are too high, or amenities that feel overpriced and barely useful. However, here everything felt just right, not too little and not too much, tailored perfectly for guests. They allowed early check-in two hours before our scheduled time and offered late check-out at 4 PM. Additionally, you can enjoy cocktails and a variety of finger foods for free while watching the night view from the 31st-floor lounge. The swimming pool is 2.6 meters deep... Later, I borrowed some tape for my luggage, and they were more than happy to lend it. Thanks to Clovis at the reception, I was well-fed with a really delicious latte, complete with rich milk foam, and I arrived at the airport with ample time to spare. It's located right in front of Nana Station, making it easy to go anywhere, and I was truly disappointed to have only spent one night there. The breakfast might not have a wide variety, but it is prepared with care rather than just relying on seasonings, and the coffee is absolutely the best. Sipping coffee while gazing at the skyscrapers in the morning made me not want to go home. I recommend this place to those who miss classic hotel service. The lounge view of the city is stunning, so skip the rooftop bar and come here instead!

name: NH Bangkok Asoke
detail: Stunning 10.0 NH Bangkok Asoke Hotel. The best hotel! May 3, 2026 This is a fantastic hotel, NH Bangkok Asoke. I can recommend it to people from all over the world. First of all, the superior location directly connected to the station is the reason I chose this hotel. After my actual stay, I deeply experienced the convenience. It’s just a short walk from the BTS Sukhumvit Station exit, and there’s no problem even with a suitcase. The hotel is also directly connected to Terminal 21, which has a rich selection of dining options and supermarkets, making it very convenient. The hotel excels in both hardware and software aspects. When I arrived in the early morning, they stored my luggage for me, and since the room was prepared relatively early, they allowed me to check in ahead of time. All the staff were very friendly, and I was particularly touched by the warm hospitality of the Thai staff at the front desk. My room had a city view, which was particularly nice, but it was completely soundproof from the noise of other rooms, making it very comfortable. The room was equipped with a bathtub, and the toilet also had a washing function. There is a swimming pool and bar on the top floor with a great view. The gym is also fantastic. Additionally, there’s bottled water provided every day. I sincerely want to stay at this hotel again.

name: The Quarter Silom by UHG
detail: This accommodation is very convenient, with well-developed transportation and amenities nearby. The cleanliness of the room is satisfactory, and the overall environment is tidy and comfortable. The staff is warm and professional, making you feel at home. The facilities are complete, meeting various needs, and the overall value for money is extremely high, making it highly recommended.

name: Asia Hotel Bangkok
detail: The overall stay experience was very satisfying, with a high cost-performance ratio. The location is convenient, the room is spacious, the sleep experience is comfortable, and the view is also satisfactory. Both the guest rooms and public areas are kept very clean, the facilities are complete and practical, and the staff are polite and attentive. Performance in all aspects is stable, making it suitable for those looking for a comfortable and convenient accommodation experience.

name: NH Bangkok Sukhumvit Boulevard
detail: I stayed for one night at the end of January. It is a 5-minute walk from BTS Nana Station. I took the ARL and BTS from the airport and arrived at the hotel in 60 minutes. Since it is close to Nana Station, even first-time travelers can easily reach the hotel with their suitcases. The staff was friendly, and I could get into my room right away. The room was clean, and the air conditioning kept it cool for a comfortable stay. The desk in the room is large and easy to use, which is convenient. There are many restaurants near the hotel, making it convenient. There was no noise even at midnight. I would like to stay here again next time.

name: Awtan Sukhumvit
detail: BTS Phrom Phong is within walking distance to Villa Market. While you need to cross a pedestrian crossing to get to MSphere, it can be said that it is almost right in front of you (a few minutes walking). However, the facility is old, and the room I stayed in couldn’t hold water in the bathtub. But the shower was sufficient, so it wasn’t a problem. It took a while to get a response, but I thought it was convenient that I could contact the front desk via LINE. The pool was empty, spacious, clean, and comfortable.
